audit.why: 53.42% over 1505 games. Skill through level 5, Ahri from 6 onward — matches packet.levelChart and the kits: Taliyah has no burst that starts on a stationary Ahri.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere (packet defect: sequencingCues 0). Threaded Volley scales 7/6/5/4/3s, Seismic Shove 14 -> 8s and costs 0 mana at rank 5, Unraveled Earth 14s flat, Weaver's Wall 180/150/120s.
audit.why: Her Q dropping to 3s is why the poke phase gets worse, and a 180s ultimate is why your early roams are free.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into spikes[0], breakdown.cooldowns, ahead, wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: FACTUAL ERROR repeated across whys[0], whys[3], early, spikes[0], wants.you[1] and wants.foe[0]: Taliyah's W is called a wall ('Q-W wall combo', 'wall utility', 'used W to reposition terrain', 'Use W to reshape lane terrain'). Seismic Shove is a knock-back/throw; the wall is Weaver's Wall (R). The decisive interaction — Unraveled Earth stuns anything that DASHES through it, so Spirit Rush across her mines stuns you, and Seismic Shove exists to throw you into them — was never stated.
audit.why: Riot text: W 'causes an area of ground to erupt and throws enemies within it in a direction of her choosing'; E 'if enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them'. Ahri's R is flagged as a dash.
audit.corrected: W re-described as a throw, R named as the wall, and the E-versus-Spirit-Rush interaction stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers on rows 5-7: win[4..6] read 'Ahri' while phases[4..6].side read 'Skill'.
audit.corrected: phases[4..6].side flipped to Ahri; rows 1-4 already agree at 'Skill'.

edits.before: Taliyah's Q-W wall combo lets her chip you down and reshape lane terrain, so patience and wave management matter more than mechanics, making this an even skill check.
edits.after: Threaded Volley is 1000 range and hits 5s at rank 3, so she chips you off the wave; Seismic Shove throws you rather than walling — the wall is her ultimate.

edits.before: This uncertainty holds since her wall utility gives strong zone control and roam setup without any reliable way to punish you if you play at range.
edits.after: It holds because Unraveled Earth (14s) only punishes you if you dash into it or Seismic Shove throws you in — at range she has no way to start on you.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are a genuine skill matchup: Taliyah's Q-W combo lets her chip you down and reposition the lane terrain to her advantage, and if you overextend chasing trades she can wall off and poke freely, so patience and wave management matter more than raw mechanics here.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are a genuine skill matchup: Threaded Volley out-ranges your orb at 1000 to 970 and chips you for free, and Seismic Shove throws you toward her rocks rather than away, so patience and staying off Worked Ground matter more than raw mechanics here.

edits.before: Taliyah's W wall control and Q spam let her zone the wave and set up ganks by reshaping terrain, so this window is an even skill check on wave management and dodging her Q chains.
edits.after: Threaded Volley drops to a 5s cooldown at rank 3 and Worked Ground makes the reuse hit harder, so this window is a skill check on stepping off her rocks and never dashing into E.

edits.before: Look to punish her when she's out of mana or has used W to reposition terrain
edits.after: Punish her the moment Seismic Shove is spent — 14s at rank 1, 8s maxed

edits.before: Use W to reshape lane terrain and create Q sightlines for extended poke
edits.after: Shove you into Unraveled Earth's minefield for a free stun and burst

edits.before: - Taliyah Seismic Shove: matchup-defining — The shove into Unraveled Earth is her whole setup — sidestep it and the burst whiffs. Check it before every step-up. - R Spirit Rush (last dash) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Seismic Shove is 14s at rank 1 and free to cast at rank 5 — its only job is throwing you into Unraveled Earth. - Unraveled Earth is 14s flat and stuns anything that dashes through it, so never open Spirit Rush across her mines. - Step up the moment both are spent.

edits.before: Taliyah wins by landing Seismic Shove, denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Taliyah wins by shoving you into Unraveled Earth, stunning your dash out, and bursting before you land.

edits.before: If Taliyah opens the score, reset expectations and respect Seismic Shove doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm with Q clears and stay relevant through charm picks.
edits.after: If Taliyah opens the score, stop walking onto Worked Ground and never dash across her mines. After a second, farm with Q clears and hunt your charm picks in the other two lanes.

edits.before: Carry through picks — a landed charm is a won fight, and your dashes manufacture charm angles no one wards against.
edits.after: Carry through picks — she has no dash and no escape but her ultimate, so a landed charm outside her mines is a kill.

edits.before: Ahead, hunt the map: shove with Q, dash-flank every river, and charm-pick Taliyah's teammates until the lane lead is a game lead.
edits.after: Ahead, shove with Q and roam first: Weaver's Wall is 180s at rank 1, so she cannot answer your early roams and every fight starts a man up.

edits.before: That is Taliyah’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Dashing over her minefield stuns you — that is her whole setup.

edits.before: Q both ways through the wave on his last-hits — the true-damage return is most of your early poke.
edits.after: Q both ways through the wave on her last-hits — 970 range answers Threaded Volley's 1000 politely.

notes: The 'Taliyah's W is a wall' error had propagated into six fields; the wall is Weaver's Wall (R) and W is Seismic Shove, a throw. The genuinely decisive interaction — Unraveled Earth stunning any dash through it, i.e. Spirit Rush — appeared nowhere and is now in cooldowns, enemyWin and dontsFull[0]. FLAG: the kit file gives Threaded Volley a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's own description mentions only slow; I did not assert grounding anywhere. suspectNames flagged 'Her Weaver's Wall' — FALSE POSITIVE, that is the correct R name; 'Fox Fire' vs 'fox-fire' in late is only a hyphen and I left it. Did not assert whether charm interrupts Threaded Volley's cast or whether tenacity shortens the mine stun.
